name: The Initiate
tagline: You belong to an ancient secret order of monster slayers. You have training, tradition and backup, but also the Sect's politics and orders to deal with.
luckSpecial: Whenever you burn a Luck point, your Sect suffers a setback, like a reckless project or an operation that goes badly wrong.

moves.intro: Besides the basic moves, you have four Initiate moves. The first (about your Sect) comes free, and you choose three more from the list.

auto.name: Sect Contact
auto.trig: Each time a mystery begins and you are on good terms with your Sect
auto.full: The Sect offers helpful information or support in the field.
auto.part: They give you a mission linked to the mystery. If you complete it, you also get some info or help.
auto.miss: The Sect asks you to do something wrong.
auto.note: Failing a mission or defying an order leaves you in the Sect's bad books until you make amends. The sheet does not name this move, so the name is just a label.

choices.name: Ancient Fighting Arts
choices.summary: With an old-style hand weapon you do +1 harm, and you also get +1 on protect someone rolls.

choices.name: Mystic
choices.summary: Each successful use of magic gives you +1 forward.

choices.name: Fortunes
choices.trig: Once per mystery, when you consult the Sect's prophecies or fortune-telling about what is coming
choices.miss: The information is wrong, and the Keeper decides how it hurts you.
choices.note: Each hold point can be spent on one of these: have a useful item to hand; arrive just in time wherever you are needed; give yourself or another hunter +1 forward; or warn someone in hindsight about an attack so it never takes place.

choices.name: Sacred Oath
choices.summary: You may vow to pursue one goal and give up something while you do (for example talking, all food except bread and water, drink, lying or sex). The Keeper has to agree, and the sacrifice should be as big and hard as the goal. While you keep the vow and work toward the goal, you get +1 to rolls that directly serve it, and you mark experience when each session ends. Breaking the vow means -1 ongoing until you make amends.

choices.name: Mentor
choices.trig: When you contact your mentor in the Sect for information (name them when you take this move)
choices.full: Your question gets a straight answer.
choices.part: Choose one: they are busy and cannot help, or they answer but you owe them a favour.

choices.name: Apprentice
choices.summary: You have a student (name them) and it is your task to pass on the Sect's ways. The student is an ally of the subordinate type, motivated to do exactly as you instruct.

choices.name: Helping Hand
choices.summary: When you help out another hunter and it works, they get +2 rather than the normal +1.

choices.name: That Old Black Magic
choices.summary: Casting a spell lets you use its effect to put one of the investigation questions to the Keeper (the ones from investigate a mystery).

gear.title: Old-fashioned weapons
gear.intro: Pick two or three, depending on your Sect's traditions.
gear.note: Fighting arts or Obsolete gear in your Sect means three old-fashioned weapons. Modernised or Nifty gadgets means you may take two modern ones. Any other Sect gives you a split: one modern weapon plus two old-fashioned ones.

gear.title: Modern weapons
gear.intro: Pick up to two, depending on your Sect's traditions.
gear.note: Take two if the Sect is Modernised or has Nifty gadgets, otherwise one (paired with two old-fashioned weapons). With Fighting arts or Obsolete gear you get three old-fashioned ones and the sheet gives no modern weapon.

extras.title: Your Sect
extras.intro: Your order is an old secret society that hunts monsters. Think about where it began, how long it has existed, whether it is religious, why it hides, and how it finds new members.
extras.placeholder: Describe your Sect: origins, age, religion, secrecy, recruitment...

extras.title: Sect traditions: good
extras.intro: Choose two. The Keeper uses them to decide how the Sect behaves.

options.label: Fighting arts
options.detail: Means you pick three old-fashioned weapons.

options.label: Modernised
options.detail: Lets you pick two modern weapons.

options.label: Nifty gadgets
options.detail: Lets you pick two modern weapons.

options.label: Obsolete gear
options.detail: Means you pick three old-fashioned weapons.
